what: Catnip10 Graph-Oracle Benchmark Accessors for SplitAligner
title: Catnip10 Graph-Oracle Benchmark Accessors for SplitAligner
text: SplitAlignerR R reference implementation track SplitAligner branch-coordinate framework. current release provides Catnip10 graph-oracle benchmark executable, audit-ready R package: users can load frozen primitive branch axis, inspect oracle cell states, recover fused-coordinate membership, validate benchmark accounting identities. split-based empirical gene-tree mapping engine active development. Documentation site: https://wujiaqi06.github.io/SplitAlignerR/

title: Catnip10 Graph-Oracle Benchmark Accessors for SplitAligner
Catnip10 Graph-Oracle Benchmark Accessors for SplitAligner
Catnip10 Graph-Oracle Benchmark Accessors for SplitAligner
text: seed release focuses bundled Catnip10 graph-oracle benchmark branch-coordinate ledger accessors. includes: catnip10_expected() / catnip10_matrix() wide primitive-coordinate oracle matrix; catnip10_summary_counts() per-regime status accounting; catnip10_fusion_groups() graph-oracle fused-coordinate membership; validate_catnip10_oracle() deterministic seed-release sanity checks; catnip10_oracle, bundled data object containing frozen species tree, branch-label crosswalk, per-cell oracle states, fusion groups. Catnip10 benchmark discordance-free design. intended exercise graph-defined observed, NA_fuse, NA_struct ledger states taxon pruning. NA_topo expected benchmark empirical gene-tree discordance outside Catnip10 oracle fixture.

what: Catnip10 benchmark expected oracle output — catnip10_expected
title: Catnip10 benchmark expected oracle output — catnip10_expected
text: Return deterministic expected gene--branch coordinate matrix Catnip10 10-tip coordinate-audit benchmark one taxon-deletion regime. Values kept character strings numeric branch lengths explicit missingness labels (NA_struct, NA_fuse) preserved exactly emitted independent graph-theoretic oracle. Rows full tree (*_step0) followed seven cumulative deletion steps; columns 17 primitive branch coordinates unrooted axis (ten terminals t1–t10 seven internals N_12–N_18), preceded gene_id.
